what: To test the base without my change I ran `git diff > fix.patch; git checkout <files>; ...; git apply fix.patch`. The patch file held difftastic's side-by-side text, `git apply` said "No valid patches in input", and the edit was gone (rewritten from the script that made it). Same class as records-2.
cost: 10 minutes; it would have been the whole change had it been larger
cause: diff.external is difftastic, so `git diff` does not print a patch
whys: a patch was taken with plain git diff
the default output of git diff here is for reading, and nothing says so at the point of use
records-2 recorded it as a row, and a row is read only when searched for
class: a command whose output looks like its usual format and is not
prevention: a how-to row: take a patch with `git diff --no-ext-diff`, and test a base in a detached worktree instead of reverting files; the stronger form is GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF unset for agents' shells
workaround: git diff --no-ext-diff; a base worktree (git worktree add --detach) for baselines
